name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task consists of two independent hard commands – “Get into the locked room.” and “Pick up the ball.” – without any ordering cue. According to the guidelines each lone commanded step must have its own hard Existence clause. Therefore a hard Existence(target_room_entered) is missing. The added clause Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) is not expressed in the task (no “before/after/then” wording) and is redundant with the environment’s constraints; it introduces an unwarranted order. Fix: remove the Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) clause and add a hard Existence(target_room_entered) clause.
